messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

input.request: Password reset in our web app. The user says they forgot their password. The web app looks up their account in the users database. The app emails a one-time link through an email service. The user opens the link in their email and chooses a new password, which the app saves.

assumptions: The web app and its Users database are our own system, grouped in one zone.
The email service is a third-party provider, so it is drawn as an external node.
The user opens the emailed link in the web app, and the new password is entered there.
Saving the new password is a write back to the Users database.

reply.text:
I've drafted the graph: the user, the web app and its Users database (grouped as "Your app"), and the email service as an external provider. The flow runs from the forgot-password request, through the account lookup and the emailed link, to the new password being saved.

I assumed the user opens the link in the web app, and that saving the new password writes back to the Users database. Is the graph right, or should anything change?
